source(output(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [SUBSCRIBER_ID],[STATE_ID],[FULL_NAME],[DOB],[CASE_ID],[MEMBER_PHONE],[MEMBER_EMAIL],[SERVICECODE],[SERVICE_STARTDATE],[SERVICE_ENDDATE],[PROVIDERNAME],[BARRIERS],[QUANTITY],[POCEFFDATE],[SCOPEOFSUPPORTSTOBEPROVIDED],[CareCoordinator_Name],[CareCoordinator_Phone],[CareCoordinator_Email] FROM [EXTRACT].[ACCESS2CARE_STAGING]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> MEMBERELIGSP
MEMBERELIGSP sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = DATA)) ~> FlatFileDestination
